phrases.latin: Hīc, in trānsitū peditum, viam trānsīmus. Dā mihi manum.
phrases.english: Here, at the zebra crossing, we cross the road. Give me your hand.

sources: Lewis & Short: transitus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 358.
